item.title: OSIRIS Solutions Supports euroCRIS 2026 Conference
item.description: OSIRIS Solutions is proud to announce its support for the euroCRIS 2026 conference, highlighting our commitment to open, interoperable research information systems and collaboration within the research community.

item.title: OSIRIS Solutions officially supports the Barcelona Declaration
item.description: OSIRIS Solutions is now an official supporter of the Barcelona Declaration on Open Research Information. This is a statement of our commitment to transparency, openness and collaborative research infrastructures.
